title: Air traffic controller watches the F-5 chase
summary: Jose Manuel Fernandez tells of Air traffic controller watches the F-5 chase, about 1986 at Congonhas airport, São Paulo, Brazil, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: You know, the object was just playing hideand seek. it would just show up and appear at a very distant point.

plain: Jose Manuel Fernandez, an air traffic controller at Congonhas airport in São Paulo, Brazil, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a night in 1986 when Brazilian F-5 fighter jets chased unknown objects in the sky. He says the object seemed to be playing hide and seek, popping up and then appearing again at a very distant point. The story matters to him because, if true, it would mean military jets chased something they could not catch.
